title: Igitutu kiri inyuma y'intebe y'ubwami
intro: Uhagaze mu bigo vy’ubwami bwa kera bukomeye, aho umutware w’ububasha yitangaje ko ari imana ku bantu bose. Inyuma y’uwo mutware hari umusuku yiyemeje, yajejwe ivyipfuzo bihambaye kuruta ibindi vyose vy’ubwami. Bompi hamwe, baragira umugambi kandi bagategura, bakanka kwumviriza imburi z’intumwa yarungitswe kubayobora. Woba ushobora guhishura uwo musuku w’intahemuka uwo yari nde?
clues: Nabaye mu bwami bukomeye bwatwarwa n’umuntu w’ububasha yivugira ko ari we afise ubumana ku bantu bose.
Nakoze nk’umusuku yizigirwa n’uwo mutware, nshitsa ivyipfuzo vyabo vyose n’itegeko ryabo ryose.
Igihe intumwa ya Allah yaza mu gihugu cacu iduhamagara mu kuri, jewe n’umutware wanje twaranse kwumviriza.
Nategetswe gucana umuriro munini no gutegura amatafari y’ibumba yo kwubaka inyubakwa nini.
Umutware wanje yashaka kwubaka ikibanza kirekire cane ku buryo coshika mw’ijuru ubwaryo.
Amaherezo, jewe n’umutware wanje, ingabo zacu, twarakubitwa, turarohama mu binogo vy’ikiyaga.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kubaka umunara kugira ngo ushikire mw’ijuru .
Kuvyura abantu mu gusenga ibigirwamana vy'amabuye .
Gutsinda igisagara gikomeye biciye ku itegeko ry’Imana .
trial.answer: Kubaka umunara kugira ngo ushikire mw’ijuru .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yaraduzwe aja ahantu heza cane mu kirimba ciza cane .
Yubahwa n'ubwami n'ubwenge buva ku Mana .

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
